### Healthpeak Properties Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Increases Full Year 2026 Earnings Guidance


November 02, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/584270836/files/doc_news/Healthpeak-Properties-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-and-Increases-Full-Year-2026-Earnings-Guidance-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Healthpeak Properties, Inc. (NYSE: DOC) ("Healthpeak"), a leading owner, operator, and developer of real estate for healthcare discovery and delivery, today announced results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND RECENT HIGHLIGHTS**


- Net income of $0.02 per share and FFO as Adjusted of $0.44 per share
- Outpatient Medical new and renewal lease executions totaled 846,000 square feet, bringing year-to-date Outpatient Medical lease executions to 3.2 million square feet


- Subsequent to the third quarter, 1.3 million square feet of Outpatient Medical leases have been executed or are under letter of intent ("LOI")


- Lab new and renewal lease executions totaled 480,000 square feet, bringing year-to-date Lab lease executions to 1 million square feet


- Subsequent to the third quarter, 643,000 square feet of Lab leases have been executed or are under LOI
- Lab total occupancy increased sequentially by +130 basis points ("bps") and is up +270 bps since year-end 2025


- Janus Living (NYSE: JAN) reported year-over-year revenue and Adjusted EBITDAre growth of 78% and 101%, respectively
- Acquired, or under contract to acquire, four life science buildings totaling approximately 510,000 square feet across three campuses for approximately $233 million
- Entered into a new $500 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan facility
- Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDAre was 4.7x for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
- Recent corporate impact and sustainability achievements:


- Named to the Top 10 in Real Estate from 3BL Media's 100 Best Corporate Citizens List
- Named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Real Estate
- Certified as a Great Place to Work 2026–2027
- Named one of U.S. News & World Report’s 2026–2027 Best Companies to Work For in the Real Estate and Facilities Management category, as well as the West Region category


To learn more and view the Corporate Impact Report, please visit[www.healthpeak.com/corporate-impact](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.healthpeak.com%2Fcorporate-impact&esheet=54633187&newsitemid=20261102951319&lan=en-US&anchor=www.healthpeak.com%2Fcorporate-impact&index=1&md5=d9bb95542c6f624256eeb5fba3f7e3f1)

**JANUS LIVING THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL AND OPERATING HIGHLIGHTS**


- Revenue of $268 million, up 78% compared to the prior year quarter
- Adjusted EBITDAre of $105 million, up 101% compared to the prior year quarter
- Total Adjusted Net Operating Income of $76 million, up 81% compared to the prior year quarter


- Same-store Adjusted NOI increased 25.9% and margin expanded 360 bps


- Closed $1.75 billion of senior housing acquisitions during the third quarter, consisting of the previously disclosed $1.0 billion that closed from July 1 through August 3 and an additional $743 million that closed subsequent to August 3 through quarter end
- Subsequent to quarter end and through October 30, completed approximately $370 million of senior housing acquisitions
- As of October 30, Janus Living had approximately $1.2 billion of liquidity including cash and available credit facility capacity
- Under binding purchase agreements for approximately $82 million of additional senior housing acquisitions


Janus Living, Inc. is a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust that owns high-quality communities across the United States, and is majority owned by Healthpeak. Healthpeak owns 214.7 million shares of Janus Living common stock and operating partnership common units, representing a 69% equity ownership as of September 30, 2026. Janus Living is consolidated into Healthpeak’s financial statements, with the approximately 31% not owned by Healthpeak reported as noncontrolling interest.


**LAB INVESTMENTS**


Healthpeak has acquired, or is under contract to acquire, four life science buildings totaling approximately 510,000 square feet across three campuses for approximately $233 million. Each acquisition is part of, or an extension of, an existing Healthpeak campus where the Company's local scale and relationships position it to drive near-term leasing.


On September 30, 2026, Healthpeak acquired the senior construction loan secured by HQ Point and acquired the remaining equity interest for a combined $105 million. HQ Point is a two-building, 236,000 square foot lab campus in San Diego’s Sorrento Mesa submarket that is currently 29% occupied.


Healthpeak is also under contract to acquire two life science properties that are expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 or early 2027, subject to customary closing conditions.


- South San Francisco: Healthpeak is under contract to acquire a 145,000 square foot life science building for approximately $92 million. The property is currently 49% occupied and sits adjacent to an existing 146,000 square foot Healthpeak life science building and between The Cove and The Shore, two Healthpeak campuses totaling more than 2 million square feet.
- Cambridge: Healthpeak is under contract to acquire the remaining 51% ownership interest in 100 Acorn Park Drive, a 129,000 square foot life science building on the Cambridge Discovery Park campus for approximately $36 million. The property is currently 53% occupied. Upon closing, Healthpeak will own 100% of the 605,000 square foot Cambridge Discovery Park campus.


These three opportunistic acquisitions have a blended in-place occupancy of 41%, a current cash yield of approximately 5%, and an expected stabilized cash yield of approximately 9-10%.


A presentation highlighting these investments is available at[https://ir.healthpeak.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com&esheet=54633187&newsitemid=20261102951319&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com&index=2&md5=09f6abcda5173a70c83232c62a484cb9) .


**OUTPATIENT MEDICAL ACQUISITION**


In October 2026, Healthpeak acquired Westway One, a 146,000 square foot Class A medical training facility in Houston, Texas, for $38 million. The property is 100% leased to affiliates of HCA Healthcare, with 11 years of remaining lease term. The acquisition represents an initial capitalization rate of approximately 7.4%, adds to Healthpeak's approximately 3.4 million square foot outpatient medical portfolio in Houston, and expands its portfolio of HCA nursing and professional education facilities.


**OUTPATIENT MEDICAL JOINT VENTURE RECAPITALIZATION**


As previously disclosed, in July 2026, Healthpeak entered into a joint venture with affiliates of Brookfield Asset Management (“Brookfield”) through the contribution of an 86-property outpatient medical portfolio valued at approximately $2.1 billion. Healthpeak received proceeds of approximately $1.025 billion for the sale of the 49% interest.


**BALANCE SHEET**


Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDAre was 4.7x for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


In October 2026, Healthpeak entered into a new $500 million unsecured delayed-draw term loan facility. The term loan matures in October 2030 and bears interest at SOFR plus 80 basis points based on Healthpeak’s current credit ratings. The unsecured term loan facility was undrawn at closing.


As of October 30, 2026, Healthpeak had $3.8 billion of liquidity, including cash, availability under its revolving credit facility, and undrawn term loan commitments.


**DIVIDEND**


On October 1, 2026, Healthpeak's Board of Directors declared a monthly common stock cash dividend of $0.10167 per share for each of October, November, and December of 2026, representing an annualized dividend amount of $1.22 per share. The dividend is payable on the payment dates set forth in the table below to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the corresponding record date. Future dividends are at the discretion of Healthpeak's Board of Directors.

**ABOUT HEALTHPEAK**


Healthpeak Properties, Inc. is a fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) and S&P 500 company. Healthpeak owns, operates, and develops high-quality real estate focused on healthcare discovery and delivery.


**NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES**


Nareit FFO, FFO as Adjusted, Total Same-Store Cash (Adjusted) NOI, Adjusted EBITDAre, and Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDAre are supplemental non-GAAP financial measures that we believe are useful in evaluating the operating performance and financial position of real estate investment trusts. See "September 30, 2026 Discussion and Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" for definitions, discussions of their uses and inherent limitations, and reconciliations to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with GAAP, available in the Investor Relations section of our website at[http://ir.healthpeak.com/quarterly-results](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com%2Fquarterly-results&esheet=54633187&newsitemid=20261102951319&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fir.healthpeak.com%2Fquarterly-results&index=6&md5=11b5fbe186cee0dcb3148709d7d2fd30) . See also the "Funds From Operations" section of this release for additional information. Additionally, as used herein with respect to Janus Living, Adjusted EBITDAre, Total Adjusted Net Operating Income, and Same-Store Adjusted NOI are supplemental non-GAAP financial measures that we believe are useful in evaluating the operating performance and financial position of Janus Living. See "September 30, 2026 Discussion and Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" for definitions, discussions of their uses and inherent limitations, and reconciliations to the most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with GAAP, available in the Investor Relations section of the Janus Living website at[https://ir.janusreit.com/financials/quarterly-results](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.janusreit.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results&esheet=54633187&newsitemid=20261102951319&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.janusreit.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results&index=7&md5=d8d3bc824dbc91aedd3602e70d9e953a) .
